name: personal-assistant-harness
description: A thin local harness around native Claude Code and Codex runtimes.

scripts.build: dotnet build PersonalAssistant.sln && npm --prefix apps/dashboard run build
scripts.test: dotnet test PersonalAssistant.sln && npm --prefix apps/dashboard test
scripts.typecheck: dotnet build PersonalAssistant.sln --no-restore && npm --prefix apps/dashboard run typecheck
